our_title: Else-less false conditional ordering fixed for hgraph only; hdgraph and hmesh twins still unset
ran: repro/GRA-06/order.c (sequential, pristine 7.0.18): './order "/(vert>1000)?s;"' -> 'ret=0 ... invalid=0' (fixed by 8609a5cb). Twins, pristine 7.0.18: 'mpirun -np 3 asan/bin/dgord bump.grf out -o"/(vert>100000)?s;"' -> no output, killed by timeout 120 (rc=143) on 32- and 64-bit trees; 'asan/bin/mord small2.msh out -o"/(vnod>100000)?s;"' -> 'AddressSanitizer: SEGV ... #0 _SCOTCHorderPeri #1 SCOTCH_meshOrderComputeList'. Patched: dgord rc=0 with a 9801-line ordering (32 and 64 bit), mord rc=0, no sanitizer output. check_strat_seq, check_scotch_graph_map/order/coarsen/part_ovl, check_scotch_arch_build, check_scotch_mesh_graph, check_prog_mord, check_prog_gmap, and (mpicc) check_strat_par, check_scotch_dgraph_order, check_prog_dgpart, check_prog_dgord pass on the patched 32-bit ASan tree; check_strat_seq passes on the 64-bit tree; 0 warnings on both.
severity_note: Distributed ordering hangs (all ranks) and mesh ordering crashes in orderPeri for a valid user strategy string.
evidence: hdgraph_order_st.c:200-201 'if (straptr->data.conddat.stratab[1] != NULL)  /* And if there is an else statement */ o = hdgraphOrderSt (grafptr, cblkptr, straptr->data.conddat.stratab[1]);' with no else; hmesh_order_st.c:274-275 same; hgraph_order_st.c:296-297 now 'else o = hgraphOrderSi (grafptr, ordeptr, ordenum, cblkptr); /* Apply default ordering strategy */'.
upstream_change: 8609a5cb adds the hgraphOrderSi() default for an empty else in hgraph_order_st.c

upstream_fix_review.details: Right for the sequential graph dispatcher (hgraph_order_st.c:296-297), same choice as ours (identity ordering, like STRATNODEEMPTY). Missing the two twins named in the finding: hdgraph_order_st.c:200 (distributed: all ranks hang, ran) and hmesh_order_st.c:274 (mesh: SEGV in orderPeri, ran). No new bug.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 commit fixed all three dispatchers in one commit; his fixes one. Rebased commit keeps only the two twins, with his comment wording.

review_accuracy: accurate, including the mechanism (orderPeri writes permtab[sentinel]) and the suggested fix (call hgraphOrderSi when stratab[1]==NULL). Review's note about the SCOTCH_DEBUG '&&' is cosmetic and not touched.
first_pass_critique: Right status and fix. It only patched hgraph_order_st.c and folded the GRA-13 table change into the same diff; here the distributed and mesh twins are also fixed and the two defects are separate commits.

fix_options.label: Apply the identity ordering in the else-less case
fix_options.summary: Call *OrderSi when stratab[1]==NULL, mirroring the STRATNODEEMPTY case.
fix_options.tested: 32/64-bit ASan; repro passes; check_scotch_graph_order, check_prog_gord, check_prog_mord pass.

our_title: mdeg declared double over a Gnum: fixed in hgraph, still wrong in hdgraph and hmesh
ran: Pristine 7.0.18: './order "/(mdeg>3)?s;"' (sequential) -> ret=0, no UBSan (fixed by 075a77a6). Twins: bump.grf has max degree 8 (gtst) and small2.msh max degree 6 (mtst), so 'mdeg>3' is true; yet pristine 'mpirun -np 3 dgord bump.grf -o"/(mdeg>3)?s;"' hangs (timeout, rc=143, 32 and 64 bit) and 'mord small2.msh -o"/(mdeg>3)?s;"' SEGVs in orderPeri: the condition evaluated FALSE (garbage double read from the Gnum field) and took the empty else (GRA-06). Patched: both rc=0, and 'mdeg>100' takes the else branch as expected.
severity_note: Matches review: wrong/out-of-bounds read of a strategy condition; reachable from any user ordering strategy string, but only mis-evaluates a condition (no write).
evidence: hdgraph_order_st.c:131 '{ STRATNODECOND,         STRATPARAMDOUBLE, "mdeg",' -> '&hdgraphorderstgraphdummy.s.degrglbmax' (Gnum, dgraph.h:182); hmesh_order_st.c:207 '{ STRATNODECOND,        STRATPARAMDOUBLE, "mdeg",' -> '&hmeshorderstmeshdummy.m.degrmax' (Gnum, mesh.h:127).

upstream_fix_review.details: Right for hgraph_order_st.c:231. The finding listed the hdgraph (:131) and hmesh (:207) tables as extra instances; both still declare STRATPARAMDOUBLE over a Gnum (ran: conditions evaluate wrong).
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Ours fixed the three tables in one commit; rebased to the two remaining ones.

review_accuracy: accurate; fix 'declare mdeg as STRATPARAMINT' is correct. The review cites only hgraph_order_st.c; the same table bug exists in the distributed (hdgraph) and mesh (hmesh) orderings.
first_pass_critique: Correct status/evidence. Its preferred diff bundled the GRA-06 else-branch hunk into the GRA-13 diff (two distinct defects); split here. It missed the hdgraph and hmesh twins.

fix_options.label: Declare mdeg as STRATPARAMINT

fix_options.tradeoffs: mdeg is now an integer comparison (consistent with the other graph metrics); a fractional threshold such as mdeg>3.5 is promoted per stratTestEvalCast, as for vert/edge.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Trivial type correction matching every sibling entry; cf. commit 813ef60 'Bugfix: variable type [report R. Perry]'.

fix_options.label: Add a double mirror field
fix_options.summary: Keep STRATPARAMDOUBLE and store a double copy of the max degree in the dummy struct.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Structural change for a trivial variable; only justified for fractional thresholds, which the integer form already supports via promotion.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He would not add a field where a type fix suffices.

our_title: Strategy builders format imbalance ratios into small stack buffers unbounded
ran: repro/API-07 (32-bit ASan): pristine 7.0.18 './sb 1e300' and './sb 1e30' -> 'AddressSanitizer: stack-buffer-overflow'; 'mpirun -np 1 ./sbpt 1e300' / '1e30' -> same. Patched: 1e300 and nan rejected by all 5 sequential builders ('-> 1') and the parallel ones; 0.05 -> 0; 1e30 accepted by the 64-byte builders, rejected by the 32-byte ones, no overflow. New test_strat_seq loop crashes on the pristine library (SEGV) and passes patched. check_strat_seq, check_scotch_graph_map/order/coarsen/part_ovl, check_scotch_arch_build, check_scotch_mesh_graph, check_prog_mord, check_prog_gmap, and (mpicc) check_strat_par, check_scotch_dgraph_order, check_prog_dgpart, check_prog_dgord pass on the patched 32-bit ASan tree; check_strat_seq passes on the 64-bit tree; 0 warnings on both.
severity_note: Raised from the review's medium: an attacker-free stack-buffer-overflow of 300+ bytes reachable directly from a public API argument (balrat), and from the common DBL_MAX 'no constraint' sentinel.
review_accuracy: accurate on mechanism, sites and size 309. Its '%g' suggestion changes the saved strategy text; 'reject non-finite' is adopted. First-pass claim that the FLOAT lexer has no sign so negatives already fail is WRONG: `SCOTCH_stratGraphMapBuild(&s,...,-0.5)` returns 0 on pristine (VALSDOUBLE accepts a leading sign), so negatives were silently accepted.
first_pass_critique: Its option 1 (bounded snprintf keeping %lf) is the core of the chosen fix, but it did not reject non-finite or negative ratios and its note that negatives already fail in the parser is incorrect (verified -0.5 accepted). The chosen fix adds the isfinite/negative guard and covers all 8 builders and the twins and adds tests.

fix_options.label: Reject non-finite/negative + bounded snprintf (keep %lf)
fix_options.summary: Guard each builder's ratio(s) with !isfinite/<0, convert with snprintf(sizeof) and return 1 on truncation; valid ratios keep their exact %lf text.
fix_options.tested: 32/64-bit ASan sb.c/sbpt.c; check_strat_seq/par (new rejection cases); check_scotch_graph_map/order/part_ovl, check_prog_gmap/gord/mord, dgpart.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Behaviour change only for non-finite/negative and for finite values too large to fit (previously stack smash, now error 1). Output byte-identical for valid ratios.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Matches the errorPrint+return(1) guard style (cf. b10825d) and the tools' own `-b` validation (dgmap.c rejects <0/>1); keeps %lf so SCOTCH_stratSave golden text is unchanged.

fix_options.label: Format with %.15g and validate
fix_options.tradeoffs: Cannot overflow but changes saved strategy text (0.05 vs 0.050000), visible through SCOTCH_stratSave and golden tests.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He keeps the %lf textual form, so %g would churn saved strategies.

fix_options.label: Enlarge the buffers to 320
fix_options.tradeoffs: Zero behaviour change but wastes stack and leaves sprintf and the 8192 bufftab exposed to ~10 copies of 316-char numbers.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He bounds output, he does not inflate buffers.

test_added: src/check/test_strat_seq.c and test_strat_par.c: a loop rejecting NaN, a negative and 1e300 for every builder
notes: 7.0.17 status: still-present -> 7.0.18 status: still-present. Our commit's test_strat_seq hunk had G04's test commit as context; rebased onto bare v7.0.18 (adds its own 'int i' declaration).

our_title: Public wrappers ignore their own Init result; coarsen returns 1 not 2 on context failure
ran: Non-sanitized -O0 builds of pristine 7.0.18 and of the patched series; repro/API-23: 'SCOTCH_FAIL_AT=3 LD_PRELOAD=./failmalloc.so ./map' -> pristine 'ERROR: SCOTCH_graphMapInit: out of memory' then Segmentation fault (rc=139); patched '... SCOTCH_graphMap ret=1' (rc=1).
read_only: library_graph_coarsen.c:100/:138 return (1) on context failure, library_arch_build.c:131-134, and the other wrappers were checked by reading (code identical to 7.0.17).
severity_note: Agrees with review: OOM-only NULL dereference (nondeterministic crash) plus a return-code inconsistency; most Init routines can only fail on allocation.
location_7_0_18: library_graph_map.c:411, :438, :468, :501; library_dgraph_map.c:225; library_graph_order.c:447; library_mesh_order.c:319, :351; library_arch_build.c:131-134; library_graph_coarsen.c:100, :138
evidence: library_graph_map.c:411 'SCOTCH_graphMapInit (grafptr, &mappdat, archptr, parttab);' (result dropped); library_graph_coarsen.c:100 'return (1);' after 'cannot initialize context'.
review_accuracy: accurate; most Init functions fail only on OOM, hence low. The fix 'check every Init result and return documented codes' is correct.
first_pass_critique: Correct, but method was source-read and 'needs: alloc-injection'; settled here by a malloc interposer that reproduces the SEGV on pristine and the clean return on patched. First pass did not mention the SCOTCH_dgraphMap twin, fixed here too.

fix_options.label: Check each Init result and return documented codes
fix_options.summary: Return the error when *Init fails (as SCOTCH_graphOrder already does); check stratInit in archBuild0; return 2 from graphCoarsen/CoarsenMatch on context failure.
fix_options.tested: malloc-fault repro (SEGV->return 1); 32/64-bit builds 0-warning; check_scotch_graph_map/order, check_scotch_graph_coarsen, check_prog_gmap/gord/mord pass.
fix_options.tradeoffs: graphCoarsen's return on context failure changes from 1 to 2 (the documented error); a caller treating 1 as 'not coarsenable' will notice (now matches the dgraph twin).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Mirrors the existing `if (SCOTCH_graphOrderInit (...) != 0) return (1);` idiom (library_graph_order.c:413) and the dgraph coarsen twin's `return (2)`.

fix_options.label: Make Init infallible
fix_options.summary: Allocate nothing in *Init; defer to Compute.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Changes Init/Exit allocation semantics of the public pair; larger redesign.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Too invasive for an error-handling fix.

notes: 7.0.17 status: still-present -> 7.0.18 status: still-present; both commits apply unchanged.

our_title: dgmap/dgpart rebuild the default strategy after parsing, discarding -m
ran: mpirun --oversubscribe -np 3 <bin>/dgpart 9 bump.grf /dev/null -Cd -m'r{sep=q{strat=f}}': pristine 7.0.18 completes rc=0 (user -m silently replaced by the default); patched: the user strategy reaches the mapper and hits PS2-G05-strategy-tables-api-1 ('dmapping_io.c:256:34: runtime error: load of null pointer of type Anum', SEGV at dmapping_io.c:196/:256). '-b0.1' with '-m' still gives 'options -b / -c and -m are exclusive' on both.
severity_note: Agrees: every -m strategy on dgmap/dgpart was silently ignored (wrong result), a public-tool option that never took effect.
evidence: dgmap.c:392 'SCOTCH_stratDgraphClusterBuild (&stradat, straval, ...)' and :394 'SCOTCH_stratDgraphMapBuild (&stradat, straval, ...)' run even when -m was given (dgmap.c unchanged since 7.0.17).

first_pass_critique: Accurate and thorough (library + tool repro). Confirmed its note that dgord is not affected (it only Builds when straval!=0).
